purpose: A chat would not open at all unless the phone had granted access to the address book, which QA found by granting it. The local build deliberately never asks for that permission, so the device contact manager answered nothing rather than answering none, deviceContactPhoneNumbers stayed without a value, and the chat history view -- which combines that promise -- never produced its first update, leaving the screen short of ready. It is fed an empty address book directly now: nothing here imports contacts. Also carries the stories notice saying what it is rather than where it is.
